output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    from collections import defaultdict
    pos=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]: pos[grid[r][c]].append((r,c))
    # choose complex object as stencil
    st=None
    for col,ps in pos.items():
      rs=[p[0] for p in ps]; cs=[p[1] for p in ps]
      if len(ps)>=4 and (max(rs)-min(rs)+1)*(max(cs)-min(cs)+1)>len(ps): st=(col,ps); break
    if not st:return out
    scol,sps=st; r0=min(r for r,c in sps); c0=min(c for r,c in sps)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in sps]
    for col,ps in pos.items():
      if col==scol: continue
      rs=[p[0] for p in ps]; cs=[p[1] for p in ps]
      # only line objects
      if len(set(rs))>1 and len(set(cs))>1: continue
      sr,sc=min(rs),min(cs)
      if sr<r0:
        if sc<c0: ar,ac=sr-5,sc-6; dr,dc=4,4
        else: ar,ac=sr-5,sc+4; dr,dc=4,-4
      elif sc>c0: ar,ac=sr,sc; dr,dc=0,4
      else: continue
      for k in range(2):
        for a,b in shape:
          rr,cc=ar+k*dr+a,ac+k*dc+b
          if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=col
      for r,c in ps: out[r][c]=grid[r][c] if col==scol else 0
    return out"}
